''See also: [[Bai Rou Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Bai Rou is a member of the [[Skysworn]], serving alongside his partner [[Renfei]]. He is a physically imposing man with a massive, broad build that makes him appear as solid as a wall. He typically wears green armor and a wide hat woven from dried stalks or reeds, which casts a Shadow{{!}}shadow over his face, leaving only his bright yellow eyes visible. These glowing eyes serve as his [[Goldsign]]. In combat, he utilizes golden liquid [[madra]] and has been shown using a [[Ruler technique]] known as the [[Path]] of the Amber Well to manipulate [[water]]. His presence is often described as intimidating, menacing, or oppressive. Throughout his duties, he has acted as a guard, cleared paths through crowds, and demonstrated both respect toward honored figures and intense anger during confrontations.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Skysworn partner}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|As [[Renfei]]'s partner within the [[Skysworn]], Bai Rou was present alongside both [[Renfei]] and Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref> This massive [[Skysworn]] is a [[Truegold]] who wears green armor and a hat woven from dried stalks.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10">''Skysworn'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13">''Skysworn'', chapter 13</ref> Bai Rou possesses bright yellow eyes and has the ability to forge [[Amberwell madra]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6">''Skysworn'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10" /> Equipped with iron-and-crystal manacles{{!}}manacles containing [[halfsilver]], Bai Rou utilizes an emerald [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Encounter in Ghostwater}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|After marching [[Yerin]] into the hallway, Bai Rou revealed himself as a [[Lowgold]] who possessed a thin, white replacement arm.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref> As a combatant at a more advanced stage than [[Yerin]], he wore heavy armor and utilized [[yellow madra]] that swirled around his gauntlet.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3">''Ghostwater'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref> His yellow eyes glowed from beneath the shade of his hat, and he employed a [[Ruler technique]] to command [[water]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4" /> The [[madra]] he wielded had the ability to eat through both flesh and the mind.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4" /> During their fight, [[Yerin]] confronted the individual she had been searching for, a man who held the power to decide the Fate{{!}}fate of [[Lindon]]'s apprentices.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref> It was further suggested that Bai Rou might have been the one to abandon or attack [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Underlord captivity}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|After being kidnapped and assaulted, Bai Rou expressed concern that the group represented a looming calamity.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref> As an individual involved with [[Naru Gwei]], Bai Rou was later observed wearing a wide straw hat while positioned against a railing.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c17">''Underlord'', chapter 17</ref>}}
